# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens (approximately 16-17 at the end of Anne of Avonlea)
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Schoolteacher

## Appearance

Jane is neat, sensible, and plain in appearance, lacking the striking beauty of her friend Ruby Gillis or the vivid expressions of Anne. She has a wholesome, pleasant face and presents herself in a tidy, practical manner. Her calm and uncluttered demeanor reflects her straightforward personality.

## Personality

Jane is remarkably practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact, possessing very little imagination. She is steady, reliable, and exceptionally good-natured, rarely getting flustered or envious of others. Though she does not share Anne's romantic idealizations, she is a deeply loyal friend who values traditional household virtues, order, and clear logic.

## Traits

- Practical and matter-of-fact
- Unimaginative
- Good-natured and even-tempered
- Neat and industrious

## Abilities

- Teaching and classroom management
- Domestic skills and needlework

## Goals

- To be a successful schoolteacher and maintain a sensible, proper household

## History

Jane Andrews grows up in Avonlea and becomes one of Anne Shirley's close schoolmates and a member of their childhood group of friends. She attends Queen's Academy alongside Anne, Ruby, Diana, and Gilbert, working diligently to earn her teacher's license. Unlike Anne, who pursues higher academic honors, Jane focuses steadfastly on practical preparation for her career. After graduating from Queen's, she secures a position teaching at Newbridge school. Throughout her time teaching, she remains a steadfast and reliable companion to Anne, participating in the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and local social gatherings.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the respectable Andrews family
- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis
- Studied at Queen's Academy to earn her teaching license

## Affiliations

- Avonlea School — Former Student
- Queen's Academy — Alumna / Graduate
- Avonlea Village Improvement Society — Member
